{'translation': 'Apple is now rolling out the corresponding versions to its public beta testers, marking the fifth public beta release. So far, Apple has released new public betas for iOS 27, tvOS 27, iPadOS 27, macOS 27 Golden Gate, and HomePod 27.', 'confidence': 0.97}

{'translation': "Today's release does not include any particularly notable changes, as Apple is now primarily focused on bug fixes and stability improvements in preparation for the official release in a few weeks.", 'confidence': 0.97}

{'translation': 'Additionally, Apple also released today the second release candidate (RC) of macOS Sequoia 15.8 (24H20), having previously released the corresponding developer release candidate earlier. The second release candidate of macOS Tahoe 26.7 (25G224) is also expected to be released shortly.', 'confidence': 0.94}

{'translation': "Among all of today's releases, the public beta versions share the same build numbers as the developer versions.", 'confidence': 0.97}

{'translation': 'Sign Up for the Apple Beta Software Program', 'confidence': 0.98}

{'translation': 'To enrol your device in the public beta program, visit https://beta.apple.com and follow the steps for each corresponding device. Here is how to install the public beta on iPhone:', 'confidence': 0.97}

  • {'translation': 'Visit the Apple Beta Software Program website, then choose to enrol or sign in.', 'confidence': 0.98}
  • {'translation': 'Sign in with the same Apple Account you use on your iPhone, accept the program terms, and enrol your account.', 'confidence': 0.98}
  • {'translation': 'Open Settings on your iPhone.', 'confidence': 0.98}
  • {'translation': 'Go to General > Software Update > Beta Updates.', 'confidence': 0.98}
  • {'translation': 'Select "iOS 27 Public Beta".', 'confidence': 0.98}
  • {'translation': 'Return to the Software Update screen, then tap "Update Now" when the beta appears.', 'confidence': 0.98}

{'translation': 'Apple recommends installing beta software on a secondary device. If you use it on your primary iPhone, make sure to back up first.', 'confidence': 0.97}
